# Full List of MICE Companies in India

The term MICE is an acronym for Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Events or Exhibitions. It is a business travel segment where large groups come together for a defined purpose.

This MICE tourism market is expanding its wings as the economy matures and grows in India, and there is a fast growingset of MICE companies that are coming up all all over the map to serve the market demand for their services.

To assist you with your business travel and event management needs, you will find below a categorised list of MICE companies located in the major cities of India.
